items.author: thesharmat.bsky.social
items.context: It’s hard to remember exactly since I was incredibly young, but my childhood friend at the time had a big bro that owned a SNES, with lots of the classics. One day after school my bud showed me A link to the Past, probably the first Nintendo game I ever saw. Loved Zelda ever since
items.text: A Link to the Past is a lovely first Zelda to stumble into. Having a big brother with a SNES full of classics was how a lot of us found them.

Extreme Pinball (1995) - one of the best DOS pinball games. Gravis Ultrasound PnP in action on a Pentium MMX 233 (1997). Few games really took advantage of the GUS hardware mixing, onboard RAM and interpolation. Pinball games were among the exceptions. #RetroPC #DOSGaming #GravisUltrasound
video, no description
items.text: That sounds like a great setup. Pinball was a perfect fit for that kind of sound hardware.
